standards.description: Use parentheses, brackets, or braces in numerical expressions and evaluate expressions with these symbols.
standards.ccssText: Use parentheses, brackets, or braces in numerical expressions, and evaluate expressions with these symbols.

standards.description: Write simple expressions that record calculations with numbers and interpret numerical expressions without evaluating them.
standards.ccssText: Write simple expressions that record calculations with numbers, and interpret numerical expressions without evaluating them.

standards.skillName: Two Patterns on a Coordinate Plane
standards.description: Generate two numerical patterns using two given rules, identify relationships between corresponding terms, and graph the ordered pairs on a coordinate plane.
standards.ccssText: Generate two numerical patterns using two given rules. Identify apparent relationships between corresponding terms. Form ordered pairs consisting of corresponding terms from the two patterns, and graph the ordered pairs on a coordinate plane.

domains.name: Number and Operations in Base Ten

standards.description: Recognize that a digit in one place represents 10 times as much as the place to its right and 1/10 of what it represents in the place to its left.
standards.ccssText: Recognize that in a multi-digit number, a digit in one place represents 10 times as much as it represents in the place to its right and 1/10 of what it represents in the place to its left.

standards.description: Explain patterns in the number of zeros when multiplying by powers of 10 and in decimal point placement when multiplying or dividing by a power of 10.
standards.ccssText: Explain patterns in the number of zeros of the product when multiplying a number by powers of 10, and explain patterns in the placement of the decimal point when a decimal is multiplied or divided by a power of 10. Use whole-number exponents to denote powers of 10.

standards.skillName: Reading and Comparing Decimals to Thousandths
standards.description: Read, write, and compare decimals to thousandths using base-ten numerals, number names, expanded form, and comparison symbols.
standards.ccssText: Read, write, and compare decimals to thousandths.

subStandards.description: Read and write decimals to thousandths using base-ten numerals, number names, and expanded form, e.g., 347.392 = 3 × 100 + 4 × 10 + 7 × 1 + 3 × (1/10) + 9 × (1/100) + 2 × (1/1000).
Compare two decimals to thousandths based on meanings of the digits in each place, using >, =, and < symbols to record the results of comparisons.

standards.description: Use place value understanding to round decimals to any place.
standards.ccssText: Use place value understanding to round decimals to any place.

clusters.name: Perform operations with multi-digit whole numbers and with decimals to hundredths

standards.description: Fluently multiply multi-digit whole numbers using the standard algorithm.
standards.ccssText: Fluently multiply multi-digit whole numbers using the standard algorithm.

standards.description: Find whole-number quotients with up to four-digit dividends and two-digit divisors using place value strategies and area models.
standards.ccssText: Find whole-number quotients of whole numbers with up to four-digit dividends and two-digit divisors, using strategies based on place value, the properties of operations, and/or the relationship between multiplication and division. Illustrate and explain the calculation by using equations, rectangular arrays, and/or area models.

standards.description: Add, subtract, multiply, and divide decimals to hundredths using models, place value strategies, and written methods.
standards.ccssText: Add, subtract, multiply, and divide decimals to hundredths, using concrete models or drawings and strategies based on place value, properties of operations, and/or the relationship between addition and subtraction; relate the strategy to a written method and explain the reasoning used.

clusters.name: Use equivalent fractions as a strategy to add and subtract fractions

standards.description: Add and subtract fractions with unlike denominators, including mixed numbers, by replacing them with equivalent fractions with like denominators.
standards.ccssText: Add and subtract fractions with unlike denominators (including mixed numbers) by replacing given fractions with equivalent fractions in such a way as to produce an equivalent sum or difference of fractions with like denominators.

standards.skillName: Fraction Addition and Subtraction Word Problems
standards.description: Solve word problems involving addition and subtraction of fractions with unlike denominators using visual models or equations.
standards.ccssText: Solve word problems involving addition and subtraction of fractions referring to the same whole, including cases of unlike denominators, e.g., by using visual fraction models or equations to represent the problem.

clusters.name: Apply and extend previous understandings of multiplication and division to multiply and divide fractions

standards.description: Interpret a fraction as division of the numerator by the denominator and solve word problems with answers as fractions or mixed numbers.
standards.ccssText: Interpret a fraction as division of the numerator by the denominator (a/b = a ÷ b). Solve word problems involving division of whole numbers leading to answers in the form of fractions or mixed numbers, e.g., by using visual fraction models or equations to represent the problem.

standards.description: Apply and extend understanding of multiplication to multiply a fraction or whole number by a fraction, including finding areas of rectangles with fractional side lengths.
standards.ccssText: Apply and extend previous understandings of multiplication to multiply a fraction or whole number by a fraction.

subStandards.description: Interpret the product (a/b) × q as a parts of a partition of q into b equal parts; equivalently, as the result of a sequence of operations a × q ÷ b.

Find the area of a rectangle with fractional side lengths by tiling it with unit squares of the appropriate unit fraction side lengths, and show that the area is the same as would be found by multiplying the side lengths.

standards.description: Interpret multiplication as scaling by comparing the size of a product to the size of its factors without performing the multiplication.
standards.ccssText: Interpret multiplication as scaling (resizing), by:

subStandards.description: Comparing the size of a product to the size of one factor on the basis of the size of the other factor, without performing the indicated multiplication.

Explaining why multiplying a given number by a fraction greater than 1 results in a product greater than the given number (recognizing multiplication by whole numbers greater than 1 as a familiar case); explaining why multiplying a given number by a fraction less than 1 results in a product smaller than the given number; and relating the principle of fraction equivalence a/b = (n × a)/(n × b) to the effect of multiplying a/b by 1.

standards.description: Solve real-world problems involving multiplication of fractions and mixed numbers using visual models or equations.
standards.ccssText: Solve real world problems involving multiplication of fractions and mixed numbers, e.g., by using visual fraction models or equations to represent the problem.

standards.description: Apply and extend understanding of division to divide unit fractions by whole numbers and whole numbers by unit fractions, and solve related real-world problems.
standards.ccssText: Apply and extend previous understandings of division to divide unit fractions by whole numbers and whole numbers by unit fractions.

subStandards.description: Interpret division of a unit fraction by a non-zero whole number, and compute such quotients.
Interpret division of a whole number by a unit fraction, and compute such quotients.

Solve real world problems involving division of unit fractions by non-zero whole numbers and division of whole numbers by unit fractions, e.g., by using visual fraction models and equations to represent the problem.

clusters.name: Convert like measurement units within a given measurement system

standards.description: Convert among different-sized standard measurement units within a given system and use these conversions to solve multi-step real-world problems.
standards.ccssText: Convert among different-sized standard measurement units within a given measurement system (e.g., convert 5 cm to 0.05 m), and use these conversions in solving multi-step, real world problems.

standards.description: Make a line plot to display a data set of measurements in fractions of a unit and use fraction operations to solve problems from the data.
standards.ccssText: Make a line plot to display a data set of measurements in fractions of a unit (1/2, 1/4, 1/8). Use operations on fractions for this grade to solve problems involving information presented in line plots.

clusters.name: Geometric measurement: understand concepts of volume and relate volume to multiplication and to addition

standards.description: Recognize volume as an attribute of solid figures and understand volume measurement using unit cubes.
standards.ccssText: Recognize volume as an attribute of solid figures and understand concepts of volume measurement.

subStandards.description: A cube with side length 1 unit, called a "unit cube," is said to have one cubic unit of volume, and can be used to measure volume.
A solid figure which can be packed without gaps or overlaps using n unit cubes is said to have a volume of n cubic units.

standards.skillName: Measuring Volume by Counting Unit Cubes
standards.description: Measure volumes by counting unit cubes, using cubic cm, cubic in, cubic ft, and improvised units.
standards.ccssText: Measure volumes by counting unit cubes, using cubic cm, cubic in, cubic ft, and improvised units.

standards.description: Relate volume to multiplication and addition, apply volume formulas for rectangular prisms, and find volumes of composite figures.
standards.ccssText: Relate volume to the operations of multiplication and addition and solve real world and mathematical problems involving volume.

subStandards.description: Find the volume of a right rectangular prism with whole-number side lengths by packing it with unit cubes, and show that the volume is the same as would be found by multiplying the edge lengths, equivalently by multiplying the height by the area of the base.

Apply the formulas V = l × w × h and V = b × h for rectangular prisms to find volumes of right rectangular prisms with whole-number edge lengths in the context of solving real world and mathematical problems.

Recognize volume as additive. Find volumes of solid figures composed of two non-overlapping right rectangular prisms by adding the volumes of the non-overlapping parts, applying this technique to solve real world problems.

clusters.name: Graph points on the coordinate plane to solve real-world and mathematical problems

standards.description: Use a pair of perpendicular number lines to define a coordinate system and locate points using ordered pairs.
standards.ccssText: Use a pair of perpendicular number lines, called axes, to define a coordinate system, with the intersection of the lines (the origin) arranged to coincide with the 0 on each line and a given point in the plane located by using an ordered pair of numbers, called its coordinates.

standards.description: Represent real-world and mathematical problems by graphing points in the first quadrant of the coordinate plane and interpret the coordinate values.
standards.ccssText: Represent real world and mathematical problems by graphing points in the first quadrant of the coordinate plane, and interpret coordinate values of points in the context of the situation.

clusters.name: Classify two-dimensional figures into categories based on their properties

standards.description: Understand that attributes belonging to a category of two-dimensional figures also belong to all subcategories of that category.
standards.ccssText: Understand that attributes belonging to a category of two-dimensional figures also belong to all subcategories of that category.

standards.description: Classify two-dimensional figures in a hierarchy based on properties.
standards.ccssText: Classify two-dimensional figures in a hierarchy based on properties.
